description: sqlite_storage.rs:35,93,148,161,227,253,259,281,333,340: every call to id.as_bytes().to_vec() or tip.as_bytes().to_vec() allocates a 32-byte Vec<u8> from a &[u8;32]. sqlx-sqlite implements Encode<'q, Sqlite> for &'q [u8] directly (sqlx-sqlite-0.8.6/src/types/bytes.rs), so .bind(id.as_bytes().as_ref()) or .bind(id.as_bytes() as &[u8]) binds without allocation. QueryBuilder::push_bind similarly accepts &[u8]. Idiomatic fix: drop all .to_vec() calls; bind the slice reference directly. This affects all hot paths (insert_entry, get_entry, has_entry, get_parent_cids, list_tips, set_tips, advance_tips, insert_entry_and_advance_tips).
title: sqlite_storage: 10x unnecessary Vec<u8> allocation for 32-byte ID binds
